say:1:1130721001:1.text: Those bounty hunters and Quicksand Claws are all gone. Now the trade route is bustling again with caravans on their way to Alkali.
say:1:1130721001:1.source_cn: 赏金猎人和流沙之爪们都离开了，商道上又热闹起来了，都是...

say:2:1130721002:1.text: Weevil is even thinking about getting a proper job in Alkali.
say:2:1130721002:1.source_cn: 韦弗想趁这个机会去咸水镇找份正经工作。

say:3:1130721003:1.text: After all, we vagrants have nothing but our freedom. We can't even feed ourselves.
say:3:1130721003:1.source_cn: 毕竟做流浪汉除了自由一无所有，有上顿没下顿。

say:4:1130721004:1.text: It's good to have a job, work hard, and save up. At least there will be a hot meal at the end of the day.
say:4:1130721004:1.source_cn: 找份工作蛮好，卖点力存点钱，就不用饥一顿饱一顿了。

choice_prompt:5:1130721004.text: It's good to have a job, work hard, and save up. At least there will be a hot meal at the end of the day.
choice_prompt:5:1130721004.source_cn: 找份工作蛮好，卖点力存点钱，就不用饥一顿饱一顿了。

say:6:1130721005:1.text: To be honest, I don't care for Weevil much. He's always nervous and anxious... but... it's been a bit boring without him.
say:6:1130721005:1.source_cn: 说实在，我不喜欢韦弗，他容易神经紧张。但……他离开之后...

say:7:1130721006:1.text: I'm not him. I can't just turn around and uproot my life that quick. It's hard to take the first step.
say:7:1130721006:1.source_cn: 我不像他，能那么容易就下定决心改变生活方式。迈出第一步...
